messages.states.fieldHelp: Offsets start after service/PID bytes. Expected Bytes is the complete data length. A selected field uses Scale factor / Bias and overrides Response Format.
messages.validation.wholeNumbers: Query settings must be whole numbers.
messages.validation.canProtocol: Choose an ISO 15765 CAN protocol or the connection protocol.
messages.validation.flowControl: Flow-control data must start with 0x30 and use a valid separation time.

messages.validation.fieldBounds: The selected field exceeds Expected Bytes.
